title: Capitation
summary: CAPITATION, noun 1. Numeration by the head; a numbering of persons. 2. A tax, or imposition upon each head or person; a poll-tax. Sometimes written Capitation-tax.

inlines.v: CAPITATION, noun 1. Numeration by the head; a numbering of persons. 2. A tax, or imposition upon each head or person; a poll-tax. Sometimes written Capitation-tax.
